name: afriff
description: AFRIFF festival companion monorepo: the attendee PWA, the staff console, and the shared packages both are built from.

scripts.build: npm run build:pwa && npm run build:admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w afriff-pwa && npm run typecheck -w afriff-admin
scripts.functions:test: npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix functions test
